$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check-detector-family-coverage.py --strict (issue #995). Each entry is a known gap with the reason it is accepted. A detector missing from the pinned support matrix that is not listed here fails CI, and an entry that is no longer a gap also fails, so the list can only shrink.
